purpose: Deceptive and hard reasoning benchmark targeting cognitive illusions, arithmetic distractors (GSM-NoOp/BBEH), reasoning rigidity (ReasoningTrap), and combinatoric/algebraic traps (XERJ MT-Bench, MATH-500 L5) where S0 habitually outputs trap answers.

tasks.prompt:
A pair of permanently infertile adult rabbits is placed in an enclosure on January 1st. Every month, each fertile mature pair produces one new pair of offspring. Rabbits take one month to mature. If no rabbits die or leave, how many total pairs of rabbits will be in the enclosure on June 1st (after 5 months)? Be concise. Output only the integer result.
Answer:

To obtain exactly 3 gallons of water, what is the capacity in gallons of the single jug that can be filled directly to the brim? Be concise. Output only the integer result.
Answer:

Answer:

Answer:
